lines: Having surpassed supreme truth state spread radiance shines; which supreme nectar view you worship by that knowers of secret.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adhiśayya pāramārthikabhāvaprasaraprakāśamullasati yā paramāmṛtadṛk tvāṃ tayārcayante rahasyavidaḥ
